title: Abnormal cases on the UE side

entities.name: NOTIFICATION message
entities.description: A 5GMM message that can be received by the UE via non-3GPP access with access type indicating 3GPP access.

entities.name: UE-initiated 5GMM specific procedure
entities.description: A procedure initiated by the UE over 3GPP access.

entities.name: Service request procedure
entities.description: A procedure initiated by the UE over 3GPP access to request services.

entities.name: Access attempt is barred
entities.description: Condition where lower layers indicate that the access attempt is barred.

entities.name: Signalling connection established
entities.description: Condition where lower layers confirm the establishment of the signalling connection.

entities.name: Handle pending NOTIFICATION message
entities.description: UE behavior to handle the pending NOTIFICATION message as specified in subclause 5.6.3.2.

entities.name: Ignore NOTIFICATION message
entities.description: UE behavior to ignore the NOTIFICATION message once signalling connection is established.

relations.description: NOTIFICATION message handling is guarded by the access barred condition.
If access is barred, the UE shall handle the pending NOTIFICATION message.
If signalling connection is established and access is not barred, the UE shall ignore the NOTIFICATION message.
UE-initiated 5GMM procedure is ongoing when NOTIFICATION message is received.
Service request procedure is ongoing when NOTIFICATION message is received.
